1840company-1840-company:lever:9107adc1-.title: Cash Application Specialist
1840company-1840-company:lever:9107adc1-.description: We are looking for a Cash Applications Specialist who will support daily cash application operations, including payment research, reconciliation, and resolution of payment inquiries across multiple systems. This is a temporary position through June 2026, with the possibility of extension based on business needs. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, accuracy-driven environment with high transaction volumes.
responsibilities: Perform daily cash application research and support cash inflow management activities.
Conduct research on payment inquiry requests submitted by other departments, reviewing supporting documentation and identifying required next steps.
Investigate aged and complex items on the unapplied cash dashboard, focusing on older payments requiring deeper review and resolution.
Assist with resolving unapplied, misapplied, or unidentified payments using multiple internal systems and tools.
Maintain accurate documentation of findings, updates, and resolution actions related to payment inquiries.
Manage and distribute email communications related to cash application and payment research.
Utilize a cash application dashboard daily to track, prioritize, and resolve open items.
Collaborate closely with the Cash Application team to ensure timely and accurate resolution of inquiries.
Demonstrate strong time management, follow-up, and responsiveness to meet service-level expectations in a fast-paced environment.
qualifications: Prior office or administrative experience in a finance, accounting, or operations environment preferred.
Strong proficiency in Excel (VLOOKUPs and Pivot Tables).
Strong Excel skills and comfort working with data, dashboards, and multiple systems.
Quick learner with the ability to navigate new tools and processes efficiently.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and organization.
Strong written communication skills and professional email etiquette.
Proactive, reliable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:336909dc-704f.title: AI Product Designer
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:336909dc-704f.description: About Us At 3Y Health, we are building AI-driven software to empower healthcare providers and solve the overwhelming administrative complexity that consumes 40% of the industry’s revenue. Our end-to-end platform unlocks opportunities for clinician entrepreneurs, enabling medical professionals to launch, run, and grow private practices. By supporting these independent practices with the latest AI and automation, we’re helping providers reclaim their time, build thriving businesses, and deliver better outcomes for their communities. 3Y Health is backed by over $200M from top-tier investors including Founders Fund, General Catalyst, Softbank, and 8VC. About the Role We’re seeking an AI Product Designer to design an Agentic system and AI agents for healthcare. The ideal candidate is a product-minded, hands-on designer with deep experience designing LLM/agent interactions (tool use, function calling, RAG, evals) and strong systems-thinking/design-ops chops (ideally with founding-designer experience at a YC/venture-backed startup). This role calls for a dynamic product design leader who can drive end-to-end delivery of agentic workflows and align cross-functional partners across sales, operations, marketing, recruiting, and product. As an AI Product Designer, you will own design strategy, information architecture, and execution of the agent platform and design system. RESPONSIBILITIES - Design AI interfaces and agent workflows (chat, tools, actions) end-to-end—from problem framing and user flows to high-fidelity Figma and production QA. - Collaborate with AI engineers to design interfaces that handle real-time data and dynamic outputs. - Prototype rapidly using Figma (advanced prototyping), React, Replit, and Cursor; when helpful, use lightweight code in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or Framer; run usability tests, instrument analytics, and iterate based on controlled experiments and session reviews. - Simplify complex lab tasks into intuitive layouts and user flows. - Drive innovation by exploring new AI design opportunities and creating 0→1 designs that push the limits of creative AI applications. - Contribute to the long-term vision of AI at 3Y, shaping the roadmap and scaling AI capabilities across the company. Qualifications - 7+ years in product design (5+ in complex B2B/enterprise); track record shipping AI-powered features or intelligent interfaces at scale. - Founding designer (YC or venture-backed) experience strongly preferred; portfolio showing systems thinking, data-dense UI, conversational patterns, and a cohesive design system with measurable impact. - Expert Figma (design tokens, components, advanced prototyping); comfortable with rapid interactive prototyping (HTML/CSS/JS or equivalent). - Fluency in LLM/agent concepts (prompt patterns, tool use/function calling, RAG trade-offs, evals) and how they inform UX and product design. - Skilled in product analytics, experimentation, and AI-augmented design workflows (ChatGPT/Claude, Midjourney/DALL·E, Copilot). - Experience working with cross-functional teams. - Ability to work 5 days a week in our New York office with a fully in-person team. Compensation The estimated salary range for this role is $135,000 - $175,000. Total compensation for this position may also include stock options. Note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors.

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:87.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. THE MANDATE: INDUSTRY DISRUPTION AND 10X SCALE: Vision: Product Foundry is Replit's internal engine for innovation. We move Replit beyond being a collaborative development environment to becoming the foundational operating system for the entire next generation of software, where AI Agents are the primary actors. The 10x Goal: Our purpose is to launch high-risk, full-stack 0→1 initiatives that define and establish entirely new, multi-billion-dollar product categories. We are seeking non-linear growth opportunities, fundamentally aiming to 10x Replit's value and addressable market by proving out unprecedented technical primitives and disruptive Go-To-Market strategies. The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators and high-leverage users and enterprises, equipping them with tools that enable them to build anything, anywhere. Candidates that do well here will certainly go on to build their own companies in the future! This is a high visibility role reporting to EXECUTION MODEL: HIGH-AGENCY FOUNDING TEAMS - Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders—not just specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous squads built for velocity and maximum technical leverage. This model is centered around an Engineer DRI (Directly Responsible Individual) who maintains total ownership over the initiative's technical, product, and launch success, supported by fractional PM and Design resources. - Cadence: We enforce rapid iteration and rapid market validation via 3-week sprints per initiative. This cadence forces fast deployment, immediate user feedback, and tight alignment with the internal betting table process, mirroring the intensity and speed of a lean startup. REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience - Technical company founding entrepreneurial or high visibility side projects experience preferred but not required - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code. - Strong track record leading complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders - Experience building and operating platform systems that other teams depend on - Strong product judgment: you can balance UX, speed, correctness, and long-term maintainability - Comfort working in modern web stacks such as TypeScript, React, Node.js, Postgres EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU’LL WORK ON - Helping Replit Agent build viable alternatives to the world’s most popular SaaS vendors (Data, Decks, Videos, etc) - Replit Agent becoming a full principal within a large number of third party services (read and write) - You can use Replit fully within a wide range of chat, agentic and commerce environments This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Full-Time Employee Benefits Include: 💰 Competitive Salary & Equity 💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only) ⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance 🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability 🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave 🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays 🚗 Commuter Benefits (In-Office & US Only) 📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend 🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment 🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only) 🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings ☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only) Want to learn more about what we are up to? - Meet the Replit Agent https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IYiVPrxY8-Y - Replit: Make an app for that https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zd9hzngFwY - Replit Blog https://blog.replit.com/ - Amjad TED Talk https://youtu.be/kCudFI4tcpg?si=l4ViCejV_f2RZkDi Interviewing + Culture at Replit - Operating Principles https://blog.replit

jobgether-jobgether:lever:12fc4ee3-fbd3-.title: Chief of Staff - Commercial Strategy
jobgether-jobgether:lever:12fc4ee3-fbd3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Chief of Staff - Commercial Strategy based in the United States. This is a high-impact strategic role at the intersection of commercial growth, healthcare strategy, and executive leadership. You will identify and launch new growth opportunities across markets, partnerships, and product-led initiatives. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, taking ideas from initial sizing and business cases through to measurable traction. You will work closely with Commercial, Product, Clinical, Finance, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams to align priorities and accelerate growth. You will also play a central role in strengthening GTM execution, competitive positioning, and executive-level visibility. As a trusted partner to senior leadership, you will help drive operating rhythms, board preparation, and strategic initiatives across the organization. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced healthcare strategist who thrives in ambiguity, influence, and high-ownership environments. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new growth opportunities across new verticals, strategic partnerships, products, solutions, and go-to-market motions. Build compelling business cases covering market opportunity, financial rationale, required resources, risks, competitive positioning, and expected outcomes. Partner with Product, Clinical, Value Enablement, Thought Leadership, Partnerships, and other subject-matter experts to shape and validate new initiatives. Develop differentiated GTM positioning based on market intelligence, buyer needs, competitive dynamics, and measurable customer outcomes. Translate strategic opportunities into practical execution plans, coordinating cross-functional workstreams, resolving dependencies, and maintaining momentum through initial traction. Define success criteria and track progress against strategic commitments, ensuring initiatives remain focused on measurable commercial outcomes. Strengthen the broader GTM motion through competitive intelligence, win/loss analysis, market research, and field insights. Collaborate with commercial enablement and solutions teams to improve discovery-to-proposal velocity, solution credibility, and RFP quality. Partner with finance and actuarial stakeholders to strengthen financial modeling, risk quantification, and ROI frameworks for complex healthcare opportunities. Facilitate cross-functional strategic meetings, maintain project visibility, remove blockers, and communicate commercial progress and risks to senior leadership. Help shape and operate the executive committee cadence, including agendas, pre-read materials, decision capture, and follow-through. Support board meeting preparation by creating clear, consistent narratives across commercial, product, and financial priorities. Own strategic cross-functional projects and special initiatives, proactively identifying stalled work and driving resolution across teams and executives. Requirements 7+ years of experience in healthcare GTM strategy, strategy consulting, commercial leadership, or a closely related field. Deep knowledge of the payer or provider landscape, including value-based care, population health, risk adjustment, quality, and Stars. Demonstrated success taking a B2B healthcare growth concept from market assessment and business case development through GTM execution and measurable traction. Experience working directly with executives or boards on operating rhythms, strategic initiatives, meeting preparation, cross-functional tracking, and follow-through. Strong understanding of commercial strategy, market sizing, competitive positioning, financial modeling, and GTM planning. Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Clinical, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and executive stakeholders while creating alignment around shared objectives. Comfortable operating in amb

pineservices-pine-services:lever:a5ed2c4.description: Regional Accounting Manager – ANZ Pine Services Group • Remote (Australia-based) • Reports to Group Controller About Pine Services Group Pine Services Group is a long-term holding company dedicated to the growth and legacy of premier Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) service partners and global business application companies. As a branch of Evergreen Services Group, we are committed to being the best home for ongoing company growth, ensuring that each brand in our community retains its unique identity while winning in their respective market. With a growing international portfolio, we are always looking for talented individuals to join our team. Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Regional Accounting Manager to serve as Pine’s financial steward across our Australia and New Zealand operating companies. Reporting directly to the Group Controller (US), this role is the first line of accountability for the accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of ANZ financial reporting. The ideal candidate is a technically strong accountant who thrives in a multi-entity, fast-paced environment, can build trusted relationships with OpCo leadership, and knows how to deliver clean, consolidated reporting upstream with minimal noise. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? Parking Lot Attendants are responsible for ensuring all vehicles come out clean from the car wash tunnel. The Parking Lot Attendant engages with all customers and members. They are responsible for maintaining and replenishing all car wash cleaning products for our members and keeping a clean workspace. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality, and have We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
